answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nadir of the next round. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the gale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
